blurb: Dredge Harbor Boat Center LLC is a family-run marina established in 1939, offering 180 in-water slips and a 160 boat dry stack storage building. It serves the boating community along the Delaware River and includes a member's club called "The Craft." The marina operates year-round with seasonal hours for parts, fuel dock, and service office.
